procedures.name: SetOptions
procedures.doc: Sets account schedule export options including account schedule lines, column layout, and currency settings. Configures the basic export parameters for Excel generation without financial report context.

procedures.name: SetOptions
procedures.doc: Sets comprehensive account schedule export options including financial report context. Configures all export parameters for Excel generation with financial report integration.

procedures.name: SetUpdateExistingWorksheet
procedures.doc: Controls whether to update an existing Excel worksheet or create a new one. Enables modification of existing workbooks while preserving non-data content.

procedures.name: SetFileNameSilent
procedures.doc: Sets the output file path for silent Excel export without user interaction. Enables automated export scenarios where file path is predetermined.

procedures.name: SetTestMode
procedures.doc: Enables or disables test mode for Excel export operations. Test mode allows validation and debugging without full file generation.

procedures.name: SetUseExistingTemplate
procedures.doc: Configures the export to use an existing Excel template for formatting and layout. Enables template-based Excel generation with predefined formatting and structure.

procedures.name: SetSaveToStream
procedures.doc: Configures the export to save Excel data to a stream instead of a file. Enables in-memory Excel processing and custom output handling.

procedures.name: GetSavedStream
procedures.doc: Retrieves the saved Excel data as an output stream for custom processing. Provides access to generated Excel content for further manipulation or transmission.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCalcColumnValue
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before calculating column values during Excel export. Enables custom modification of currency settings and column layout parameters.

procedures.name: OnAferCalcColumnValue
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating column values during Excel export. Enables custom post-processing of currency settings and calculated column data.

procedures.name: OnIntegerOnAfterGetRecordOnAfterAccSchedLineSetFilter
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after applying filters to account schedule lines during data processing. Enables custom filter modification and additional filter criteria application.
